Cipla Medpro South Africa (Pty) Limited is the third-largest pharmaceutical company in South Africa. Headquartered in Cape Town, it is a wholly owned subsidiary of India's [Cipla Limited](https://cipla.africa/), supplying affordable generic and chronic medicines across the public and private healthcare sectors. [](https://za.linkedin.com/company/cipla-africa)

- **Core Therapeutic Segments:** Respiratory care, antiretrovirals (ARVs for HIV/AIDS), cardiology, urology, oncology, diabetes, and central nervous system (CNS) conditions. [](http://www.sapcconference.za.org/cipla/)

- **Market Position:** One of the top and fastest-growing medicine suppliers in South Africa, providing cost-effective alternatives to branded pharmaceuticals. [](https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/projects/enaleni/)

### Corporate Background

- **Origins:**

Established and grown locally before expanding via corporate structures, eventually becoming fully acquired by its long-term partner Cipla India in a major 2013 investment.

[](https://www.stellenboschbusiness.ac.za/management-review/news/cipla-medpro-acquisition-pre-and-post-merger-story)

- **Operations:** Manufactures and distributes medications tailored to Southern African health needs through localized facilities like Cipla Medpro Manufacturing and Cipla Distribution Gateway. [](https://cipla.africa/our-presence/)
